title: Fluency check-in
description: Addition and subtraction within 20 — confirms the foundation and calibrates starting difficulty.

title: 2-digit +/− (no regrouping)
description: Numbers up to 100 that don't require carrying or borrowing.

title: 2-digit +/− (with regrouping)
description: The harder case — carrying and borrowing. This is where most of the real difficulty up to 100 lives.

title: Multiplication as grouping
description: ×1, ×2, ×10 — the easiest, most conceptual facts, framed as "groups of".

title: Core tables
description: ×3, ×4, ×5 — still friendly numbers, builds fact recall over counting.

title: Harder tables
description: ×6, ×7, ×8, ×9 — the facts kids actually struggle with. This stage should linger.

title: Full table fluency
description: All of ×1–×10 mixed together, randomized, timed lightly.
